name: Lucy
source:
Lucy is Emma's best friend, with her mother being a lecturer at North Brooke University, and her father often being over seas on business trips, Lucy craves attention that for many years was given to her by her best friend. After she had grown up a bit she found herself desiring more than just attention, and if she couldn't get it from Emma, she was going to get it from somewhere else.

[In game description]
